dataset.description:
The Data Management Plan (DMP) for the GAI4FD-Evaluation Methodology for Generative Artificial Intelligence Super-Resolution Models for Fluid Dynamics project aims to outline the methods and protocols for handling the diverse datasets and outputs generated and processed throughout the project. 

Purpose of Data Collection and Generation
GAI4FD focuses on applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) to Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), emphasizing experimental data integration, simulation accuracy, and innovative evaluation methodologies. GAI4FD aims to create a standardized evaluation framework for Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) Super-Resolution (SR) models, specifically for two-phase flow systems. The data collected and generated will support the development and validation of this framework by providing a
comprehensive data frame for testing models and evaluating their performance across diverse scenarios.

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP)or the GAI4FD -Evaluation Methodology for Generative Artificial Intelligence Super-Resolution Models for Fluid Dynamics project (Ref. 2023.11234.PEX)  aims to outline the methods and
protocols for handling the diverse datasets and outputs generated and processed throughout the project. This document ensures that all data-related activities align with the project’s objectives and adhere to ethical, legal, and institutional guidelines. Updates to the DMP will occur as needed to reflect the project’s evolving requirements.
